2.source: Ajissa Plains, Sacred Land, Namekian Rivers
2.translation: Planícies Ajissa, Terra Sagrada, Rios Namekuseijins

3.source: Full vanilla ore set, Kikono Ore, Gete Debris, the Namek Dragon Balls
3.translation: Todos os minérios vanilla, Minério de Kikono, Detritos de Gete, as Esferas do Dragão de Namekusei

4.source: '''Namek''' (Planet Namek, dimension id dragonminez:namek) is the home planet of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian|Namekians]]: a green-skied world of Ajissa forests and blue waters. It's a full mining world and holds the Namek Dragon Balls that summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], Frieza's occupying army, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]] raid and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]] inside the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]].
4.translation: '''Namekusei''' (o planeta Namekusei, id de dimensão dragonminez:namek) é o planeta natal dos [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian|Namekuseijins]]: um mundo de céu verde com florestas de Ajissa e águas azuis. É um mundo completo de mineração e abriga as Esferas do Dragão de Namekusei que invocam [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], o exército de ocupação de Freeza, a incursão [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Invasão de Freeza]] e o [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Núcleo do Metal Cooler]] dentro da [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Estrela Big Gete]].

6.source: Namek has normal gravity (×1.0) by default, the same as Earth.
6.translation: Namekusei tem gravidade normal (×1.0) por padrão, igual à Terra.

8.source:
* '''Ajissa Plains''': home of Frieza's Ship, the Ajissa-style Namekian villages and Frieza's soldiers.
* '''Sacred Land''': the Grand Elder's region, with the Grand Elder's House and the Sacred-style villages.
* '''Namekian Rivers''': the planet's waterways, where Giant Fish and Namek frogs live.
8.translation:
* '''Planícies Ajissa''': lar da Nave do Freeza, das vilas namekuseijins no estilo Ajissa e dos soldados de Freeza.
* '''Terra Sagrada''': a região do Grande Ancião, com a Casa do Grande Ancião e as vilas no estilo Sagrado.
* '''Rios Namekuseijins''': os cursos d'água do planeta, onde vivem os peixes gigantes e os sapos de Namekusei.

10.source: Namek has the '''full ore set''' embedded in Namek stone (and its deepslate variants): coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond and emerald, so it's a good place to mine vanilla resources.
10.translation: Namekusei tem o '''conjunto completo de minérios''' incrustado na pedra de Namek (e nas variantes de ardósia): carvão, cobre, ferro, ouro, redstone, lápis-lazúli, diamante e esmeralda, então é um bom lugar para minerar recursos vanilla.

11.source:
* '''Kikono Ore''' is exclusive to Namek. It drops '''Kikono Shards''', the base material for Kikono gear (Kikono Stick, String and Cloth) and the armor-crafting recipes. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Kikono Materials|Kikono Materials]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|Armor]].
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Tech|Gete Debris]]''' is a rare ore that generates like Ancient Debris, in small veins scattered underground, with a low chance. The drained ground around the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] also hides some.
11.translation:
* O '''Minério de Kikono''' é exclusivo de Namekusei. Ele dropa '''Fragmentos de Kikono''', o material base do equipamento de Kikono (Bastão, Fio e Tecido de Kikono) e das receitas de fabricação de armaduras. Veja [[Special:MyLanguage/Kikono Materials|Materiais Kikono]] e [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|Armaduras]].
* Os '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Tech|Detritos de Gete]]''' são um minério raro gerado como os detritos ancestrais, em pequenos veios espalhados pelo subsolo e com baixa chance. O solo drenado ao redor da [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Estrela Big Gete]] também esconde alguns.

13.source:
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namek Frog|Namek frogs]]''' (and their rare Ginyu variant) are harmless wildlife.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Traders]]''' sell general goods in the villages, including a '''Big Gete Star Map''' for 16 emeralds.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Namekian Warriors]]''' defend the villages.
* The '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Capsule Corp Namekian]]''' lives in Ajissa villages and sells treasure maps to [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship|Frieza's Ship]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House|Grand Elder's House]].
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Frieza's Soldiers]]''' are hostile invaders that spawn in the Ajissa Plains and the Sacred Land.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Gete Robots]]''': while players are near a Namekian village, small groups (up to 3 per village) show up on its outskirts and march on it.
* '''Metal Cooler patrols''': around the Big Gete Star, up to 2 patrols (a [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler|Metal Cooler]] scout with 2–3 Gete Robots) roam near players.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Giant Fish|Giant Fish]] and vanilla water life (fish, squid) live in the rivers.
13.translation:
* Os '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namek Frog|sapos de Namekusei]]''' (e sua rara variante Ginyu) são fauna inofensiva.
* Os '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Comerciantes Namekuseijins]]''' vendem produtos gerais nas vilas, incluindo um '''Mapa da Estrela Big Gete''' por 16 esmeraldas.
* Os '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Guerreiros Namekuseijins]]''' defendem as vilas.
* O NPC '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Corporação Cápsula Namekuseijin]]''' mora nas vilas Ajissa e vende mapas do tesouro para a [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship|Nave do Freeza]] e a [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House|Casa do Grande Ancião]].
* Os '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Soldados de Freeza]]''' são invasores hostis que surgem nas Planícies Ajissa e na Terra Sagrada.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Robôs Gete]]''': enquanto houver jogadores perto de uma vila namekuseijin, pequenos grupos (até 3 por vila) aparecem nos arredores e marcham sobre ela.
* '''Patrulhas do Metal Cooler''': ao redor da Estrela Big Gete, até 2 patrulhas (um batedor [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler|Metal Cooler]] com 2–3 Robôs Gete) rondam perto dos jogadores.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Giant Fish|Peixes gigantes]] e a fauna aquática vanilla (peixes, lulas) vivem nos rios.

25.translation: Local da incursão [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Invasão de Freeza]]

26.source: Ajissa Plains or Sacred Land, at least 1,000 blocks from 0, 0
26.translation: Planícies Ajissa ou Terra Sagrada, a pelo menos 1,000 blocos de 0, 0

27.source: The lair of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]]
27.translation: O covil do [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Núcleo do Metal Cooler]]

29.source: The seven Namek Dragon Balls are scattered around Namek's world spawn. Find them with the Namek [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radar]] and bring them together to summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], who grants three wishes per summon. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]] has a separate set of three Dragon Balls that also summons Porunga (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm#Demon Realm Dragon Balls|Demon Realm]]).
29.translation: As sete Esferas do Dragão de Namekusei ficam espalhadas ao redor do spawn de Namekusei. Encontre-as com o [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Radar do Dragão]] de Namekusei e junte-as para invocar [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], que concede três desejos por invocação. O [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Reino Demoníaco]] tem um conjunto separado de três Esferas do Dragão que também invoca Porunga (veja [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm#Demon Realm Dragon Balls|Reino Demoníaco]]).

31.source: Travel by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]]: the '''Namek''' destination is always available and lands you at the same X, Y and Z you left from. In the story, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] ends with you repairing Vegeta's pod and flying to Namek, and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]] takes place here. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] also come back to Namek.
31.translation: Viaje de [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Cápsula Espacial]]: o destino '''Namekusei''' está sempre disponível e deixa você nas mesmas coordenadas X, Y e Z de onde partiu. Na história, a [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saga Saiyajin]] termina com você consertando a nave do Vegeta e voando para Namekusei, e a [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Saga Freeza]] se passa aqui. A [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Saga de Filmes]] e a [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|Saga GT]] também voltam a Namekusei.
